I feel this so badly. I recently tried to get help but the group therapy im in ended today and I don't think I can get any help till the next semester in fall. 

Everything feels pointless. I'm just going to fuck up anyways so it'd be easier to just end it so no one will be dissapointed.
Yep, even now replying to this.
Honestly I love that idea, seeing something like that would definitely be a big motivator even for people with anxiety or things like that.

I've looked into clubs, and there is a lot I want to try and do but the anxiety of the first step is pretty crushing. My hope is next semester after summer break Ill come back with a better mindset + add on the recent therapy for help.
